label: Pre-choice a2 commitment, early in the episode (GO, and D1 after no reward)
explanation: Update-gate unit 8 fires only at D1 and GO (never at D2, never when a state or action input is present), and almost only when the agent is about to choose a2: 99.9% of activation mass falls on trials with action==2, and at GO it tracks a strongly negative policy logit (choice < -4.4 holds 85% of mass). It is also restricted to the first ~40 trials of an episode (0 activity after trial ~55; it peaks at trials 10-29) and is stronger in episodes that start with S2 good. Within a trial it fires at GO (69% of mass) and at D1 mostly when the previous trial was unrewarded; but some of the largest activations are at D1 after a reward when the previous GO was quiet, which the predicate misses. The recorded predicate uses only the agent own upcoming choice (allowed) plus trial position and observed previous reward, with no future random outcomes. Dev: P 0.49, R 0.89, F1 0.63, mass recall 0.85. The looser (phase != D2) & (action == 2) & (ep_trial < 40) reaches mass recall 0.98 but precision 0.36: many early a2 steps stay below threshold, so magnitude probably carries episode-time/commitment information that I did not capture with a predicate. It does not fire on a1 choices, on D2, or late in episodes.
